title: Intraday Microstructure Dynamics of E-mini S&P 500 Futures: Volatility Regimes, Liquidity Decay, and Long Memory in Realized Volatility
one_line: On ES 1-min data (Apr 2024-May 2026, 529 sessions), activity and bar range decay through the day (−44% from the first to the last 30 minutes), realized volatility is highly persistent (lag-1 autocorrelation 0.71, still positive at 21 days), and mean bar range tracks realized volatility almost perfectly (r = 0.975).

findings.statement: Mean 1-min bar range 4.78 pts in the first 30 min vs 2.69 in the last.
Four volatility regimes; April 2025 tariff shock 33.9% annualized vs 9.3% normal.
Daily RV autocorrelation 0.71 at lag 1, significant to lag 21.

reported_results.headline: On ES 1-min data (Apr 2024-May 2026, 529 sessions), activity and bar range decay through the day (−44% from the first to the last 30 minutes), realized volatility is highly persistent (lag-1 autocorrelation 0.71, still positive at 21 days), and mean bar range tracks realized volatility almost perfectly (r = 0.975).

tradable_edge: No strategy. Supports our use of range-based volatility (AvgRange) and regime splits. Sample is entirely in our protected 2024+ period — do NOT use it to choose parameters.
data_fit: ES 1-min Dec 2013 → Sep 2026, NQ 1-min Jul 2021 → Sep 2026 (2024+ protected in the backtest project).
